column3: “Ram’s” specifies the horn; an eagle looms replaces like an eagle.
“Our God” replaces my God; Israel is made the subject of the introductory clause.
Approval replaces knowing; their own destruction expands the singular passive be cut off.
“Worthless” renders having no delight in the vessel.
“Like” makes the wild donkey an explicit comparison.
“For them” replaces for him; great things renders numerous things.
“As gifts to Me” rearranges the sacrifices of My gifts.
